tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking owned by the user_key account.

tools.name: check_room_availability
tools.description: Recheck the selected rate code, price, and inventory before booking.

tools.name: check_skill_update
tools.description: Check whether a newer TourMind Booking Skill version is available.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create a hotel booking from a verified rate. A valid user_key is required.

tools.name: get_hotel_detail
tools.description: Get static hotel details, facilities, rooms, policies, and images.

tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: Create a payment request for a booking owned by the user_key account. CNY WeChat Pay and Alipay return a one-time device-aware payment link.

tools.name: query_booking
tools.description: Query a booking owned by the user_key account.

tools.name: query_room_rates
tools.description: Get live room types and rate products for a hotel and stay.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search candidate hotels by region, coordinates and radius, or fuzzy keyword.

tools.name: search_location
tools.description: Resolve a region, point of interest, landmark, shopping mall, or hotel name to TourMind regions, hotels, or coordinates.
